title: Friday
description:
S1 E1
Before the sun sets, Craig must get his friend out of trouble, find a new job, so his parents don't evict him, escape his girlfriend long enough to capture a new woman's heart and survive a confrontation with the neighborhood menace.

title: Next Friday
description:
S1 E1
A streetwise man flees South Central Los Angeles, heading to the suburbs and his lottery-winner uncle and cousin to avoid a neighborhood thug with a grudge who has escaped from prison. But trouble soon follows, and the suburbs will never be the same.

title: Friday After Next
description:
S1 E1
Craig and Day-Day have finally moved into their own apartment, but a ghetto grinch breaks in and steals all their Christmas presents—and the rent money. To avoid eviction before Christmas, the cousins take jobs as unarmed security guards at a strip mall.

title: The Players Club
description:
S1 E1
A single mom tries to work her way through college, moonlighting as an exotic dancer.

title: Harlem Nights
description:
S1 E1
In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray and his adopted son, Quick, run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. Gangster Bugsy Calhoune pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone to close Club Sugar Ray down.

title: Head of State
description:
S1 E1
When Washington desperately needs a presidential candidate just weeks before the election, they need someone sure to lose. They pick Mays Gilliam (Chris Rock), an unknown local politician from a down-and-out D.C. neighborhood, to be their puppet.

title: Top Five
description:
S1 E1
Written, directed and starring Chris Rock, TOP FIVE tells the story of New York City comedian-turned-film star Andre Allen, whose unexpected encounter with a journalist forces him to confront the comedy career—and the past—that he’s left behind.
